in_marathi.name: Girvaan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girvaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Girvaan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'gir' meaning cow and 'van' meaning lord. This name signifies one who is the protector and provider for his people, just as a cow provides nourishment to her calf. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often depicted as the protector of cows, and the name Girvaan can be seen as a tribute to his divine qualities.
